headline: Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Posts Record Profit Before Tax of Rs34.6 Billion
summary: Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited approved annual financial statements for FY2026, delivering a record profit before tax of Rs34.6 billion and recommending a final cash dividend of Rs3.00 per share.
why: SNGPL is Pakistan's largest natural gas transmission and distribution utility company.

impacts.name: Sui Northern Gas Pipelines
impacts.why: Achieving record corporate pre-tax profits supported shareholder cash dividend payouts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Record annual operating profits and cash dividend declarations boosted investor demand on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
